Source: 'LSI Financing LLC, a separately managed portfolio company formed to indirectly own royalty purchase agreements and loans in the life sciences space.' Instrument is an EQUITY (LLC) interest, but the look-through economic exposure is specialty/structured CREDIT: royalty purchase agreements + loans = contractual top-line cash-flow claims, typically capped MOIC/IRR -> debt-like. Classify PRIVATE_CREDIT_FUND (fund/vehicle exposure to private credit). NOT COMMON_EQUITY (understates the debt-like nature) and NOT DIRECT_LENDING (you hold the vehicle interest, not the loans/royalties directly). Pipeline had COMMON_EQUITY here; SAME instrument is inconsistently tagged DIRECT_LENDING/LOAN in other Blue Owl funds (1747777, 1869453) = misclassification, plus same-FV affiliation-axis dupes.
